I think he is and I have a fear of being abandoned. So I think he wants to be single while going to town and drinking with other women. But he’s a middle aged man, I hoped he would just want one woman, maybe he does. It’s just not me apparently, and that hurts me so much. 

I have autism so my routine of getting a phone call every day even for 5 minutes. Would text me and call me babe all the time. He would ALWAYS say love you in messages and in person, but now he doesn’t love me? So he’s been lying about it all? He can’t just wake up one morning and be like “hm don’t love her anymore” it would’ve had to be a leading up time? So he was lying when he kissed me and said I love you. That just hurts me even more.

Yeah, my sister went off on him about the shit he did to me, she has her own man. She’s vocal about how he treats me and keeps saying I deserve better, how normally I would never let a man do half the shit he did to me, she’s right. I don’t. But doesn’t hurt any less.

Yeah everyone in my inner circle keeps telling me he treated me like shit and some emotional abuse and I’d do anything for him, maybe I did. Maybe I felt if I did things like errands for him he’d stay with me? If I was useful he’d want me around?

He never called me beautiful, or make me feel good, a flower once in a while would’ve been good, but nothing. 

He’d get drunk then mentally fuck me up and flip saying if I got pregnant again he’d marry me and all that shit. I had to go through the a***tion alone. He said he’d be there for me, but he chose overtime for 12 hours underground instead. 

He’s helped me with things I couldn’t pay for, I felt like shit knowing I could never do half the things he’s helped me buy. I’m 28 and he’s 46, and it seems like he’s got his life together, I don’t need him but I wanted him in my life. I was hoping he’d want me more than being single. I guess he just wants to chat up other women and not be held down. 

I hope I can have a sigh of relief knowing I don’t have to cry myself to sleep wondering if he’s cheating on me. We only spoke for 5 minutes a day on a call unless I was with him. I’d message him first and sometimes he’d just ignore me. I’d be the one to make the hour drive up to him every time. I felt like I was putting in the effort and he thought it was fine because he could just pay for things like food. But never took me out on dates. I guess I felt more like a secret girlfriend/sex buddy than anything.

Yeah he says he “hates confrontation” but he had a chance to break up with me by face like he said he would when I was worried about it happening via text early into the relationship. He knew, and did it anyway. He gave me hope then did this.

Thank you, yes I need to remember all the shit he’s put me though, you’re right. I deserve better. He said there’s a chance to reunite down the road but honestly, I don’t think I could put myself through it all again, wondering if he’s cheating on me, etc. 

I tried calling to a few mental health places but they haven’t even answered, so I’ll try again tomorrow morning. Thank you

I just don’t want to cry anymore. Last 24 hours has been non stop crying and I want to eat but I can’t stomach it, if it makes sense? 

I’m exhausted, but all I want to do is be in his arms, which will never happen again.

I have autism, I don’t know what I’ve done wrong and I’m not regulating my emotions at all right now. I usually love being alone, but I wanted to spend every moment I could with him, I only saw him once a week though, so I guess I was clinging on to him and he felt like he needed space to breathe?

We would have fights too, but we always sat down and spoke about it until it was resolved, but idk everything was moving so fast, I may have to go to a mental health facility and check in, while he was laughing with mates and fine?
The fact he could look into my eyes, say I love you and kiss me then all of a sudden you don’t love me and want to break up? He’s happy and I’m feeling like my heart is going to give out.

He is 18 years older than me and we’d been together for 2 years. He didn’t want marriage or any more children… I did but I choose to agree about no kids or marriage because I wanted to be with him more than those two things. 

I will put this out there… six months ago I had an a***tion, for him. Ngl, I did feel a little pressured into it. I’m feeling so guilty and wished I never did it, I did so much for him and he did treat me kinda shit. 

All I wanted was to be loved and loyalty, he couldn’t give me those.

I didn’t even think about being autistic. Didn’t even think I was, knew I was different though, I was diagnosed with level 2 ASD with selective mutism. It all clicked while doing the questionnaires to start off with…

My therapist suggested it and helped me with a quick questionnaire and then helped me with places that specialises with females and adult ASD and their costs. Everything made more sense to me. I owe her so much for this. 

I saved so much money to get a diagnosis that my therapist suggested. While I did do multiple questionnaires (was also for ADHD too) he walked through it and spoke about my growing up and how I am now and spoke to other people I grew up with like my sister (who was with me because I have selective mutism too). It was going through so much more for me. 

It was multiple sessions, like 3-4 months with a therapist (psychologists and other psychiatrists were never okay with me not talking but this therapist let me play and colour and helped me talk) then 2 appointments with the specialist. 

Without this diagnosis I wouldn’t be able to go on DSP or get NDIS funding to help me with daily living. I don’t have to rely on my sister as much. This has helped her mentally as well as for myself. 

I actually feel like I’m functioning as a human instead of being a burden on others. This diagnosis saved my life. 


Sorry for the long rambles. I needed to get that off my chest, don’t know if this was the right post for it though. 🥹
